text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Stayers Stakes. Mejiro 
Bright felt no nervousness; in fact, she 
seemed rather delighted.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She wants to run long-distance races like 
the Tenno Sho (Spring). She wants to be a 
strength to the Mejiro family— Her 
childhood dream was about to come true.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And watching from the stands to witness 
Mejiro Bright's run was none other than 
the head of the Mejiro family.
